title: Top 20 slowest requests
description: requests ranked by end-to-end request_time (llm-response-body-*, one row per request_id; request_id is the join key to the request doc). upstream = time in the llama-server instance; tokens = usage reported by the model

title: Request rate
description: requests per bucket (llm-request-body-*) — read together with Response rate: the gap is in-flight or lost requests

title: Response rate
description: responses per bucket (llm-response-body-*) — a response lands when the stream ends, long after its request

title: Latency by instance
description: end-to-end request_time per upstream instance (upstream_addr ip:port) — whether one llama-server is consistently slower

title: Proxy vs upstream time
description: total request_time vs time inside the upstream (upstream_response_time); the gap is nginx proxy/buffering overhead (body capture, SSE pass-through)

title: Error requests
description: requests whose upstream returned 4xx/5xx (upstream_status >= 400) with their request_id — open the id in LLM Body Logs (Discover) to read the payloads. status is the upstream response code

title: Completion cap (max_tokens)
description: max_tokens cap sent per request (llm-request-body-*) — the completion budget the client allows
